notes.title: Visual overhaul of our artstyle!
notes.notes:
You might have noticed that the artstyle on our Steam store page got a complete visual overhaul!

Over the past year, we’ve been working tirelessly behind the scenes to replace all of the old 2D art with new beautifully rendered 3D images. While there’s still quite a bit more to do, we’re proud of how far we’ve come. Our goal was to give you a sneak peek at what’s to come, so we’ve updated our store page to reflect the game’s current look and feel. Get ready to experience a fresh new vibe as you dive back into the world of romance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39282057/0e1603047103536380840832dd3e1ffd86c52cc0.jpg[/img]

We’re also working on updating the trailer and movie clips to match the new visuals. Keep your eyes peeled for those, as they’ll be dropping soon!

Want to stay in the loop with all of our progress and updates? Join our community on Discord, where we share monthly updates and listen to your feedback! It’s your chance to help shape the game, and we’d love to hear from you.

[url=https://discord.gg/sDYDTUB]Join our Discord here![/url]

Thanks for being a part of this journey with us. We can’t wait for you to experience everything we’ve been working on!

notes.title: Participating in the Steam Visual Novel Fest - Aug 7
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce 'Match, Talk, Date! - A modern dating sim!' will be featured in Steam's Visual Novel Fest starting next week Monday the 7th of August at 10AM Pacific time zone. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39282057/b81e691702478426badece12abe23298f30265dc.jpg[/img]

In order to better show off the game I also included a new screenshot featuring the custom character creator and updated the trailer a bit to show all the new features!


Be sure to check out my game and all of the other visual novels participating!

See you on the Visual Novel Fest.

notes.title: Steam page is live!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to reveal that the Steam store page of ‘Match, Talk, Date! - A modern dating sim!’ is now live!

Don't forget to wishlist the page to stay up-to-date when the game releases!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39282057/df70f44c0b4091b56265941c523a4a5544f3c2c5.png[/img]

‘Match, Talk, Date!’ is a modern take on the classic dating sim genre, where you use a dating app to chat to a diverse cast of unique characters and eventually ask them to go out on a date with you! Play how you want and date who you want, both men and women are available!

Can you convince them to go out on a date with you, or are you going home alone?


[previewyoutube=EU-mq-s6bkk;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your support, and see you in the next update!
